title: Sienna Miller Filmed a Major Madden Retirement Scene on Her First Day
excerpt:
The actress describes the pressure of beginning with John Madden's Raiders departure.
The scene brought her together with Nicolas Cage, Christian Bale and Kathryn Hahn.
body_md:
Sienna Miller has recalled the intimidating experience of filming a pivotal scene for Madden on her very first day on set. She portrays Carol Davis in the film, which dramatizes John Madden's departure from coaching the Raiders.

The sequence brings Madden and his wife Virginia together with Raiders owner Al Davis and Carol. Madden is considering retirement because of serious health problems, while Al and Carol attempt to persuade him to continue coaching.

Miller told CinemaBlend that beginning with such a significant dramatic scene was frightening, particularly alongside performers including Nicolas Cage, Christian Bale and Kathryn Hahn. Hahn, who plays Virginia Madden, said she also felt nervous.

In the film's version of events, Virginia helps Madden commit to retirement despite pressure to remain with the team. The sequence combines a consequential career decision with a heightened dramatic presentation.

The interview focuses on the actors' experience of making the movie; its depiction of historical events should not automatically be treated as a definitive documentary account.
